title: Riccati Reductions for Modified Bessel Ratios: Bernstein Positivity, Exact Certificates, and Transfer Obstructions
summary: Several open inequalities for ratios and logarithmic derivatives of the modified Bessel functions $I_ν$ of the first kind and $K_ν$ of the second kind reduce to sign questions for quadratic Riccati expressions. We isolate this reduction and use it in two directions. First, for the quotient $W_ν(z)=zI_ν(z)/I_{ν+1}(z)$, the canonical product for $I_{ν+1}$ yields the partial fraction $W_ν(\sqrt{s})=2(ν+1)+2\sum_{n\ge1}s/(s+j_{ν+1,n}^2)$, where $j_{ν+1,n}$ is the $n$-th positive zero of $J_{ν+1}$.
